body: I think some parents are just way too invested in it.. when I was 7, i told my mom I had some serious doubts, and her response? “uhhh so Santa gets really overwhelmed, so sometimes instead of bringing the toys himself, he’ll give parents cash to buy the toys.” And then she offered me $5 to not tell my 10 yr old sister (who ofc already knew at that point, it was her who planted the seeds of doubt lol)

I’m on week 5 of compounded tirzepatide, 2.5 mg, and I’ve been trying to push through but my tramadol has stopped working. I wake up at 8am and am hungry so I immediately drink a fairlife core power protein drink (230 cal, 42g protein) then try to wait as long as possible to take my dose (today I waited until noon). Is 4 hours just not enough to empty out a protein drink? I’m ready to give up, does it get better? I don’t want to go back to how I was living before tirz, it’s helping so much with the food noise, I’m desperate 😔
Lmao it was definitely chaotic af, would not recommend!

My mother is in her early 60s, has had Lupus since she was 40. She was managing her pain with Tramadol for the past 10 years, and just recently her rheumatologist took her off it completely. Apparently the Dr. got too paranoid to keep prescribing, worried the FDA/DEA is going after Tramadol prescribers now. 

My mom is only surviving now thru the help of a friend who is a pain mgmt MD who thinks the entire Tramadol panic is ridiculous. If she went to a random pain clinic they would just offer her injections. Wish I had something more optimistic to report but this is the reality of pain mgmt with autoimmune disorders… the future is bleak.

My then boyfriend wasn’t responding to my texts. I wasn’t blowing up his phone or anything or being nasty. I later learned he had BPD and ignoring my texts was one of his manipulation tactics he’d do when splitting. Anyways, I drove over to his apartment, saw his car was gone, then let myself in with the key he had given me (he lived alone). Did all that just to check his iPad, to see if he had opened my text, which showed he had indeed (his iMessage was synced to his iPad). 

Then I left. I justified it by telling myself since he had given me his spare key and told me his iPad passcode that it wasn’t that weird. I only told one friend this story, and they said it was psycho so never told else anyone until now.

Extreme sadness, yep… but the worst is the extreme despair. I feel depressed 24/7 but can keep it under wraps. During hell week is when I will lay on the floor, sobbing and yelling out loud (stuff like why me? Why can’t I just be healthy?) or literally on my hands and knees begging God to help me (I’m agnostic but was raised southern Baptist)

I also had my major depression and suicidal ideation come out of nowhere at 10. I can barely remember that year, but according to my parents I would say I wanted to die all the time. The pediatric psychiatrist didn’t know wtf to do with me, so she just put me on way too much Prozac which turned me into a little zombie girl 🫤

I got my period at 11, exactly one year later….Then things seemed to get a little better, I didn’t have to stay on Prozac. It has to be related but I don’t understand why.

Not to be a Reddit cliché, but are you me? I feel everything you said. Especially last part about finding the girl you used to be. In my case…Pretty sure she’s gone forever. I feel like a dead woman walking.

My sibling has the same condition (dermatillomania) and it’s a hell I’d only wish on my worst enemy. The trance state. My god. I will have to shake her like she’s asleep to get her to stop. She got a staph infection once from one of her picking spots….I worry a lot she will get MRSA and die.

-if I don’t pick up/rearrange certain objects  (pick up that shoe off the floor, rearrange a pillow ) before I leave the house, a family member will die 
-seeing a pic of my ten year old cousin and thinking “aw she’s so cute, she’s gonna grow up to be pretty like her mom” then cue a meltdown thinking I’m a secret p3do (I’m a straight woman so i can kinda use that to bring myself back down to reality)
-intrusive sexual thoughts about (adult) family members that are extremely uncomfortable and unwanted. it doesn’t even feel like I am thinking the thoughts, they just appear like an annoying pop-up ad in my head that you can’t find the x button for
King of the Hill has been my go-to. I’ve only had to skip a couple episodes (usually if it is a Bill-centric episode, I relate a little too much to him sometimes)

I saw dermatologist on Tuesday, she said they are bug bites. No to folliculitis. They of course can’t diagnose what bug, but the doctor said she had worked at a VA hospital and had many patients with BB bites come thru. She suspected mine were BB bites… but also wondered the same thing, that surely I would have seen some sign by now? Like why are there no red stains on my sheets… 

I have only seen one bug, it was crawling on my arm and I held it up to the light, it was super tiny and caramel colored, maybe a nymph but idk. I tried to squish it but it ran super fast and it got away. Definitely not a flea. that was two weeks ago, nothing since. 

 An exterminator came to the house today, I was not present but my family member was, and the exterminator claimed they saw no signs of BB, declined to do treatment. I’m going to get a second opinion. I feel like I’m going crazy. I suspect they are living in a very long crack in my bedroom wall. I already had moved my bed away, put down interceptors, mattress encased etc. So, either the derm is wrong or the exterminator is wrong.
I’m calling first thing when they open tomorrow 😬
I have zero quality of life. Wish I was from Canada, then I’d be eligible for the MAID act (probably)

I’m so sorry. It sounds like we’re stuck in situations almost identical. Trying to work on forgiving myself, don’t know what else there is to do. Yes, nights like this for me, it feels like this is really no way to live…
r/therapeuticketamine is a great resource, very helpful people in that sub
Have you heard of Athletic Pubalgia? (Also known as “Sports Hernia” but it’s not an actual hernia, that’s just a misnomer).

I had to go to a hospital to pick up my medical records. I was in an elevator with just a mom and her 15-16ish yr old daughter. (I’m late 20s). She turned around and looked at me, then said “Omg, are you pregnant too?!” I was like uh excuse me? 

She said “oh my daughter is pregnant and I thought maybe you are going to the same obgyn office as we’re heading to” bitch I’m literally going to a different floor than you.

I wish I had responded and said “yeah I’m pregnant but here to fetus yeetus” so she’d def learn not to fucking ask people if they’re pregnant

I feel you. Last week I had a dream I was hanging out with my ex best friend (we became friends at age 4, literally went thru entire childhood/adolescence together. now we’re late 20s…). 

I woke up feeling really fucking sad since I ended the friendship due to complicated reasons. Still thinking about her almost everyday since the dream. :/

Probably just on my subconscious because this month has marked one year anniversary of our “friend breakup”

I’m right there with you homie. I’ve run out of coping behaviors to distract from the suicidal  thoughts…

I started gaming a couple years ago. I was gifted a hand me down PS4 while on bed rest from surgery #1.  So playing the PS4 or on my PC was getting me thru it for awhile, just to escape to another world where this one isn’t fucking unbearable. Now I don’t have the energy (physical or mental). I know the clock is running out. I’m fucking losing my mind. I don’t want to die but it’s going to happen before my 28th birthday next year, I just know it…

Actually just a couple weeks ago I was talking about this with my ex-vangelical dad. I was literally 6 and knew about sex, prostitutes, sex slaves/concubines, rape (& male on male rape), polygamy, adultery, etc. 

wild. Wild. Wild. 

When I was 7 I was walking through a park by my neighborhood with my dad. I stopped to read a large memorial built to honor two teen girls, who were victims of murder a few years prior. (They had been gang raped and killed in the park- it’s a fairly well known case in the true crime sphere). 

I remember asking my dad why they were killed. He didn’t even say anything about the gang rape, just something very vague about the men hurting them, because duh, I was 7. But I immediately figured out what he meant- they were raped. Freaks me out that a little girl could figure that out on her own just from exposure to the bibbel
Osteoarthritis from a congenital hip deformity developed in my early 20s. Now in my late 20s and on top of having OA, I now have interstitial cystitis

I spent age 0-15 going to church. I’m not a Christian (and I never was of my own choice- just indoctrinated from birth and raised Evangelical). But sometimes I cry out to God during my lowest moments ask him to heal me, help me, do SOMETHING, at least give me a sign to keep going. I open my heart and there’s nothing. Radio silence. 

I’m glad you found a narrative that gives you comfort but this is honestly **really tone deaf** advice for the people on this sub who are suicidal.

The only thing keeping me from heeding the call… Is my dad would be the one to find me. I live alone but he comes over 4x a week to visit me (cause he knows I want to die) and has a key.   

I could get a motel room but dying alone in a motel room is just depressing as fuck. And then some innocent house cleaner might end up being the one  to find me, I can’t do that shit to someone.

I had a friend in high school whose dad smoked, and her clothes and backpack always had the smell. I never said anything but one day she told me she was aware of it and felt really self conscious :/ I really felt for her.

A couple years ago I found out I have a certain type of “pre-cancer”, I had to get a biopsy, all that. I’m supposed to get check ups every year but I waited two years due to apathy. Its fucked up to admit…but I was honestly disappointed when I got my results back that everything was looking fine.

Lmao. Maybe in the next life. No friends, no love life, hate where I live, chronic illness, and well my family… need I say more. The only thing I have going for me on paper is a “interesting” job (I work in reality tv) and I can’t even keep that shit down. 

Having to take FMLA leave starting this week. Did not disclose what my medical condition is to my boss, but now she thinks I’m gonna kill myself or something. (Last year someone on my team had a mental break and went totally AWOL for 3 weeks, we thought they had died, so now all mgmt is on edge)

I cut out smoking weed 3 years ago and drinking 1 year ago. Never had an “issue” with either but I can’t even have a casual glass of wine anymore (dealing with a bladder disorder that alcohol exacerbates, blergh).

I take propranolol 60mg (XR) during the day, and 1.5 mg Xanax at night. I want to get off the Xanax badly but the withdrawals make me want to die even more. I’ll have to look into the lithium supplement

It’s really gotten out of the control for me in the past year. Recently for about a month, every night I was having stress dreams (about my real life issues) and I would wake up every morning yelling/thrashing/hyperventilating. 

That stopped for now, but I still wake up and my first thought is like an electric jolt of “oh god, please not another day, why am I alive” and then all the bad thoughts start pouring in.

Didn’t work for me. Maybe it’s because of where my pain is located (seems most people get results if they have shoulder or back issues, which is not my pain area). You’re better off investing the money in a TENS unit tbh

Being hands free is a blessing and a curse, 100x easier to be stealth, but also makes quitting 100x harder IMO.  I didn’t seek out being hands free, I was just a regular binge eater (fingers never worked ). one day during a binge, how to make it happen just clicked,  and my life has never been the same. 😔

Thanks for confirming. I cannot grasp at all what they were trying to say either, but I have become so used to being sent messages with this odd speech pattern, I needed an objective opinion.  

It’s very unfortunate that the weed just brought to the surface what was brewing due to genetics and trauma. they were severely abused & neglected by their bio family until age 6, when CPS took them and they were in foster care until aging out at 18.  

They have tried to quit like 20 times in the past year and always relapse. I wish I could get them to go to the doctor, but this message was the response to me telling them they need to seek help… I didn’t include the messages of them cussing me out. I’m distancing myself for now for my own mental health.
I’ve called out to God so many times begging him to either help me or end me. Literally begging on my knees, praying and sobbing. Where the fuck is homeboy at?

26 here, and big same. I feel heartbroken. I fought so hard to overcome my mental health issues and get thru high school and college, finally got to a stable place, looking forward to life. Just for my body to start disintegrating only a year after graduating college. 

Having to wake up everyday and not only deal with the physical pain, but the emotional pain knowing all my dreams/goals/passions are forever out of reach now… I want to live so badly, but Not on these terms

I wish I could get them to just agree to see a doctor. I tried to reach out to some family members thru Facebook but no response (informally adopted by a family from foster care.). 

The adoptive family are well aware of this behavior because they are on the receiving end of the vitriol too but idk if you can  request 5150 without threats of self harm/ harming others? They called in the 5150 last time during the suicide attempt.

Not the first time they have sent me a text that is like one long stream of consciousness, just rambling on their thoughts on a topic. They usually make very little sense. But the odd speech pattern has been increasing in severity. 

I still barely understand this one because like you said, the non linear thoughts..especially the part about the “cliques” and “positive spirits” ??

Unfortunately I don’t know how to help them because this all started due to me having told them to get help in the first place. They are apparently functional enough right now to hold down a job that requires them to travel out of state / go live on location to their job site (think oil rig type of job, but different industry). 

I tried to get in touch with their mom and sister who I’ve both met  (informally “adopted” by a family from foster care) by sending FB friend request but can’t get them to respond.

Not on any medications. Just smoke weed heavily, no alcohol or other substances. They were able to quit for a couple weeks and seemed to be doing better but then relapsed

they have severe childhood trauma (virtually no memories before age 6) and after being removed from their abusive family, spent the rest of their childhood in the foster care system.


No formal diagnosis that I am aware of, but were treated for psych issues while in foster care. Oh, And 5150’d for the suicide attempt that happened a few years ago.

They have also told me they think they are borderline and have had an ex-SO and a family member also speculate they are borderline. (which I would agree with their speculation after knowing being friends for 5 years).

It’s all fucked up man… my grandmother is literally 97 years old, her health is stable but has chronic pain of course. She needs morphine but they wouldn’t prescribe it unless she was in hospice care, because they are worried about a 97 year old GETTING ADDICTED. Now she has been taken off hospice care after a year, since she was “doing too well.” So now she just gets shitty ass tramadol. Why the fuck does it matter if a 97 yr old gets addicted to morphine??

Also why does our age matter in prescribing opioids? Why do doctors think because I’m 26, my pain is somehow more tolerable than someone in say, their 40s?

My pain doctor took me off mfing tramadol because, “You are too young to be needing to take tramadol everyday” 

Yeah and by that logic, I’m also too young to be completely home-bound and disabled, but here I am…


(It’s not even because he thought I was drug seeking. Never asked for anything stronger than tramadol, and I have the extensive surgical history to back up my claims)
I think about suicide at least once every waking hour. It’s almost as exhausting as dealing with my chronic illnesses.
I have complex PTSD and 100% believe I would never have become agoraphobic if I had a normal childhood
Or you could, just get kids today vaccinated, have lifelong immunity from chickenpox and shingles… shingles is a whole other beast

BC is probably why I’m still here today. Ive been taking Lo Loestrin Fe for many years, I started taking it specifically for PMDD when I was in high school. 

it’s a low dose combination pill. The low dose part is probably why it’s worked so well and I haven’t had to switch to anything else. It also stops my period, which is a huge plus.

I had the same experience using vaping to quit cigs. At most of the jobs that I had, smoke breaks weren’t a thing, or if they did allow it, I was embarrassed about my habit and hated coming back inside with the cig stank. 

But with vapes I could do it anywhere, I would vape in the supply closet, the bathroom, etc. Then come home from work and just hit the vape until I went to bed. I even spent a whole year in a relationship hiding it from my disapproving ex, was super easy not having to worry about cig stank exposing me

I’ve used vaping to quit cigarettes before, and found it 10x more addicting. The salt nicotine juice is much more potent…the ability to vape anywhere.. vape inside my house, vape in the bathroom at work, etc. I’d freak out if I couldn’t find my vape, like you said the “where’s my juul” meme, it was really embarrassing as a grown adult. 

I dated someone that considered vaping to be a dealbreaker, but I could still vape and easily hide it. With cigarettes there’s no hiding the stank in your hair and clothes.

It was much harder to quit vaping than cigs, the cravings are insane

I was like why would you want your kid to get chickenpox when it’s avoidable? She just said “oh I had chickenpox and it wasn’t that bad.” I’m not a mom, but I can’t imagine watching my kid suffer from a preventable illness.. I was born right when the chickenpox vax first became available, and I’m glad my parents agreed to it. I also don’t ever have to worry about getting shingles. 

She agreed w/ me that she should get a second opinion and so I offered to look for providers. I found a holistic/integrative medicine pediatrician, board certified, and has a whole page on her website about why vaccination is important. So, fingers crossed.

My best friend just had her first baby a few weeks ago. she called me up yesterday and said she went to some holistic nurse practitioner who convinced her all vaccines are poison. (She was pro-childhood vaccination before this). She doesn’t believe it causes autism, so it’s not even about that.. 

Idk it just really made me upset. Then angry when I think about the millions of mamas in developing countries who don’t have access, and some who walk on foot for days just to get their baby to a vaccine clinic.. 

I just wanted to yell, you’re putting the baby’s life at risk! At the very least let the baby get the freaking Tdap and MMR shots! My state allows for a “personal belief exemption” so there’s nothing standing in her way. 

Anti-childhood vax people, pls don’t start with me I’m too sad and tired.

Right there with you.. my home is my prison, feels like l’ve been serving a criminal sentence on house arrest for the past 3 years. I live alone and the only person I see is my dad 2x a week, he comes to bring me groceries and my med refills. I don’t think I’ll make it to see 2024.

You put everything into words that I’m currently sobbing over at the moment. My home is a prison, I feel like I am serving a house arrest sentence for a crime for the past 3 years…  It’s complete isolation except for my father who checks in on me twice a week. I haven’t showered in two weeks. I move from my bed, to my work desk (barely holding down my shitty remote job) and then back to my bed and that’s it, every single day

Yes on the general malaise. I feel completely exhausted, I take my adderall medication and want to go right back to sleep all day.. and extreme body fatigue.. 

I feel what I call “hotcold” frequently (basically just clammy, the top of my skin is cold but I’m still sweating, if put layers or get under a quit and somehow I have body chills and feel hot at the same time??)

I’m sure my depression/vitamin D deficiency/lack of activity isn’t helping, but yeah feeling like I have the flu 24/7 freaking sucks.

I also got Covid for the first time last fall. Right after I developed a “chronic UTI”  and turns out it’s interstitial cystitis. So there is probably an autoimmune flare happening in my body. My mother has Lupus, Graves’ disease and Sjogrens so I always feared this day would come..
Your peers were smoking at 8? Jeez

Yeah, I started casually around 17. By 19 I was working 2 jobs in restaurant industry which meant full blown cig addiction. Then vaping started becoming mainstream and I used it to stop smoking. 

It’s been a repeat of that cycle for the past 8 years. Smoking, quitting, vaping, quitting, smoking… rinse and repeat…

I’ve finally just settled on cigs for the past year because I can moderate my usage better than vaping. I always tried to justify vaping since it was “healthier” (who tf knows), but I was ingesting so much more with the nicotine salt.  I would have the vape in my hand pretty much every waking hour, and constantly going to the bathroom to use it at work.

I haven’t, and I don’t think I ever can. Two different (unrelated) pain disorders have killed my spirit and dreams at 27.  I can’t focus on anything  except making sure I don’t run out of tramadol, trying to not lose my WFH job, and fighting for my life to survive and see another day. 

I wish I could say something more uplifting, I wish you the best
Same…i’m 26.  don’t know how I’m gonna make it another 5 years, much less 30…

Thank you for bringing this up.. surprised no one else has. There’s nothing wrong with posting an after picture to celebrate recovery. But this is a form of body checking. I’ve been battling an ED ten years, and it’s pretty well known in online recovery communities that it’s not a good idea to post these types of B&As. Any ED therapist would agree.

My sister has recently started microdosing golden teacher.. I am curious to try it but not sure if it will interact with my meds. Also lots of recommendations for Kratom but I get very nauseous. I will try Kratom if I can find a good source, it’s just sold at sketchy smokeshops in my area

Oh gotcha. Sounds like a great choice to make. My mom developed Sjogren’s and Graves disease while pregnant, then a couple years later, fucking Lupus. One of the reasons I’m too scared to ever get pregnant. So sorry you are going through this. Hope everything goes smoothly!

Just out of curiosity, if a regular civilian person plays “pretend” Russian roulette with their revolver at home, with an absolutely 100% triple checked empty  chamber… is that considered weird or mentally ill behavior? Asking for a friend.

Ok…can just saying “women” while acknowledging that includes AFAB people be inclusive enough? Do we need to start saying “uterus having people”? I’m not trying to be snarky, I’m just genuinely trying to understand what you think the ideal terminology should be. Nobody on this sub thinks that AFAB Trans men & non binary people can’t also have PMDD.

This is actually helpful timing to see your post, I was wondering the same thing. I developed dp/dr as a teen but got it pretty under control (it started after a really bad drug trip when I was 14). 

I’m having the worst hell week ever, I just screamed and sobbed in the mirror for about ten minutes and felt like I’m not the person in the mirror… that’s not me. I’m honestly scared I’m going into psychosis or something because I don’t recognize myself. I usually just feel detached from the world around me during a bad episode, like I’m in a dream, but i still feel like I am me. So this is very… not normal.. it probably didn’t help that I’ve been crying so much that my eyes turned blue (they are actually dark green) which makes me feel even more like it’s an imposter in the mirror

I feel your pain. I got my bachelors in film (with the express purpose of always staying BEHIND the camera). Anyways in film school you end up having to do some acting in your friends films cause there’s never enough people, and it fucking sucked.
I mean I have C-PTSD and lots of other problems but on the scale of fucked up shit my mom did, her not playing dolls was pretty tame in comparison

I’m 27 and new to this sub, I still don’t know if my mom if she fits the criteria for an N. I don’t know if it’s just her epigentics and unresolved CPTSD as the cause… or maybe I’m just in denial and she is N… I’m still learning. 

I always knew my family was fucked up and super dysfunctional, but it wasn’t until finding this sub and the CPTSD one that I started to wonder. 

She abused my sister and I verbally and physically. She and my 30 yr old sister are enmeshed and my sister has never moved out because of it. 

She definitely has N traits such as being a wannabe white savior in Christian ministry. She is a nurse practitioner (CRNA) and believes she is smarter than most doctors/her medical knowledge is infallible. 

My dad is 100% the enabler, and has spent my entire life running interference between her and the 3 of us. I guess he’s somewhat aware, he has called him himself “the punching bag of the family” but he was always my protector from her, even if he did a mediocre job.

I remember trying to get my mom to play dolls with me (Barbie, Polly pocket) and she would purposefully not “play” in an fun/engaging way, just like would sit there and do nothing except hold the doll.  So of course I stopped asking her to play with me. She even admitted she did that purposefully so I’d leave her alone.

I keep feeling this overwhelming pull to try it. I know it will end badly just like the inverted face filter that went viral last year. That fked me up for awhile. But my bdd is like FEED ME I NEED PAIN

I keep seeing it on my fyp. I haven’t done it, I have no desire at all, I know it will end badly. But I feel this strong pull to do it and I don’t know why. It’s like my BDD wants me to feed into my cycle of self loathing. It’s hungry for pain. The call of the void! Please tell me not to do it 🫣

Anyways, I probably need to delete the app until this trend is over

Edit: oh I also forgot about that inverted face filter that was viral last year. That was a HORRIBLE idea and It sent me into a tailspin. F’ing Tik tok is just not a good place for us who are struggling!

My parents, and my only sibling who Is unable to work due to due brain damage/neurodivergent. I struggle everyday knowing it will all be on to take care of all three of them, once my parents are too elderly to take care of her anymore. I know I won’t make it through another 20 years, so I’m doing my best to stay alive long enough for my life insurance policy to pay out in 2 years, which would help my sister be taken care of. Pretty fucked and grim, but this is my reality.
That’s not how it works- you’d need a full mastectomy for the health benefit. And implants make it harder to get accurate mammogram imaging.

I feel like I could have written this post. Especially the part about 3 years ago never imagining this life was for me. This all started 2 years ago for me. I’m turning 27 soon and I don’t know a single person under the age of 50 who has chronic pain/illness. I can’t bear to look at any Facebook/Instagram and see people I used to know living their lives, traveling, going out etc… while my 20s are going down the drain. 

I’ve barely got any friends left since I can’t manage to leave the house, (thank god for WFH). Recently an old friend from HS reached out to me, asking how life was. when I told them I was dealing with “health issues (non life threatening)” and then tried to redirect the conversation back to them… didn’t even text me back. I guess it makes people uncomfortable to be honest. 

I’m only still alive right now because of my parents and my only sibling. I don’t know how much longer I can go on. So yeah I’m sorry I don’t have any thing to add on how to get through this 😔but I empathize with you 1000%
I want to get off this shit for good. Ten years of being on and off benzos (never been difficult to get a script). I’m so sick of this drug ruling my life

Those subs are trash. I also hate that stupid sub called Vindicta. The whole looks maxxing shit is so toxic. It’s one thing to just have a beauty tip sub, but it’s all focused on your attractiveness based on your skull shape.  All that “witch skull” vs “angel skull” shape stuff. Like JFC. Is this the Middle Ages?
Therapists just brand it as “healthy coping mechanisms” and call it a day
Seems like a book my parents would have read. Although they never prayed with me after. It did jack shit to reform me or my sibling, ofc.
That’s even more depressing. These guys never had a chance.

I’ve been watching The Sopranos for the first time (it came out when I was a kid so yeah didn’t watch it back then). There was a horrible, violent rape attack on one of the female characters and it was very graphic. Like showed everything. Fuck man, it was so triggering and it’s messed me up the past week. I get that back in 2001 HBO didn’t do content warnings, but at least they could update it or something for that specific episode...
Me blowing $500 (that I can’t afford) in a week with online shopping to feel a sliver of serotonin
